problem.title: Quantum capacity of a qubit Pauli channel

question.summary: Known achievable rates and converse bounds do not determine the quantum capacity of a general qubit Pauli channel.
question.importance: An exact formula would characterize the quantum communication rate of the basic four-error qubit noise model and resolve gaps left by degenerate coding gains.
question.unresolved: Determine the quantum capacity of the general qubit Pauli channel.

targetClauses.label: General qubit Pauli-channel capacity
targetClauses.text: Determine the quantum capacity for every valid qubit Pauli error distribution.
targetClauses.resolutionCriteria: Give a proved exact capacity formula or an equivalent complete characterization for every valid probability vector.
